messages.subject: Project Lyra — Patent & Know-How Licence (first draft)
messages.plaintextBody:
Oliver, Deepa,

Our first draft of the Patent and Know-How Licence is attached (v1, clean). It follows the agreed heads of terms. Key clauses to note: grant and field (clause 2), diligence/first-sale longstop (clause 3), the financial provisions (clause 5), warranties (clause 7) and the liability cap in clause 8.4 (currently 150% of sums paid in the preceding 12 months). We look forward to your mark-up.

Elena Marchetti
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
